def transform(grid):
    # Three solid divider columns split the grid into four same-sized panels.
    # Cellwise panel-combination rule to be refined from demonstrations.
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0])
    panels = []
    start = 0
    for j in range(w):
        if all(grid[i][j] == 3 for i in range(h)):
            panels.append([row[start:j] for row in grid])
            start = j + 1
    panels.append([row[start:] for row in grid])
    priority = (2, 3, 0, 1)
    return [[next((panels[p][r][c] for p in priority if panels[p][r][c] != 0), 0)
             for c in range(len(panels[0][r]))]
            for r in range(h)]
